facts.claim: BagepalJi (Bagenhalli) is a small frontier town on the right bank of the Chitravati about 90 miles north‑west of Eolar, on the old Bangalore‑Bellary road, and it is the headquarters of the Gumnayakanpalya taluk and a municipality with 415 houses.
